name: Manual discount on derived maintenance line
expected: A derived maintenance line accepts a manual discount through its dedicated derived-maintenance manual path; manual discount applied to the derived net WITHOUT breaking the contributor base. For derived net = 0.20 x list(355) = 71 and a 20% manual discount: NetUnitPrice = 71 x (1 - 0.20) = 56.8; license (contributor) net stays 355.
actual: PASS exactly. Cloned standing BoKS derived demo (0Q0WC000003FKRJ0A4) to throwaway quote 0Q0WC000003Fasf0AC, set Discount=20 on the derived New-Maintenance line (PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK), Force-repriced V21. Result: maintenance UnitPrice=71, Pre_Partner_Price__c=71 (=0.20x355 derived net BEFORE manual discount), NetUnitPrice=56.8 (=71x0.80), NetTotalPrice=56.8, Base_Price__c=355, Source_List_Price__c=355, Fortra_Product_Type__c='New Maintenance'. License (contributor) NetUnitPrice=355, Base_Price__c=355 -- contributor base UNTOUCHED. Matches existing real UI-priced controls: QLI 0QLWC000002SWnH4AW (CYB-DCS-UC-CMP UnitPrice250 disc50 -> net125 = 250x0.50, NetTotal375); 0QLWC000002SU8l4AG (disc45 -> net137.5 = 250x0.55, NetTotal412.5); derived RNM lines 0QLWC000003iXHt4AM/0QLWC000003heAA4AY with 10% disc net off the derived base.
evidence: Repro clone (deleted after verify, standing demo intact): Quote 0Q0WC000003Fasf0AC, maint QLI 0QLWC000003kkNu4AI NetUnitPrice=56.8 Discount=20 Pre_Partner_Price__c=71, license QLI 0QLWC000003kkNt4AI net=355. notes: GATE TRACED in V21 metadata: ListGroup 'Partner Discount - Derived Maintenance' (seq 21) gated by child AdvancedListFilter 'PartnerDiscountDerivedMaintenance62' = ItemIsDerived__std=true AND Deal_Type__c!='Fortra Originated' AND ItemPricingSource!='LastTransaction' AND QuoteTypeText__c!='Renewal'; group children in order: filter -> PartnerDiscountDerivedMaintenance63 (partner BKM) -> StampPartnerUnitPriceDerivedMaintenance -> ManualDiscountDerivedMaintenance (BKM). The dedicated step 'Manual Discount - Derived Maintenance' (skeleton step 81) uses AdjustmentType=PercentageStringConstant, AdjustmentValue=ItemDiscountPercentage(=QLI.Discount), InputUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice -> outputs NetUnitPrice + Subtotal->ItemNetTotalPrice. CATALOG MECHANISM-DESCRIPTION ERROR (NOT a defect): scenario proc_mechanism says 'AmountStringConstant + ItemDiscountAmount on derived line' but V21's derived-maintenance manual step is PERCENT-based (PercentageStringConstant + ItemDiscountPercentage); the ONLY amount-based manual step in V21 is the non-derived 'Manual Quote Level Amount-Based (Line-Level)' (step 82, H-01's path). The scenario's CORE assertion (derived line accepts a manual discount via its dedicated path without breaking the contributor base) is PROVEN TRUE on real reprice + cross-confirmed on real UI-priced data. Active proc = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, context v23) per METHOD_BRIEF (ExpressionSet/Version objects not queryable in org to re-confirm). defect_provenance SC-3346 is the build that introduced the derived-maintenance pricing + manual path; no regression observed.
verdict_reason: Real V21 Force-reprice of a derived New-Maintenance line with a 20% manual discount produced NetUnitPrice=56.8 (=71x0.80, the derived net Pre_Partner_Price__c=71 reduced by the manual percent) while the license contributor net stayed 355 -- discount applied via the dedicated derived-maintenance manual path without breaking the contributor base, matching expected and cross-confirmed on existing UI-priced controls.
